title: Build approval queue and blocked action view
purpose: Make pending human decisions visible and exact enough for safe operator approval or denial.
scope: Render pending approval queue from durable run and audit state.
Show actor, tool, resource, parameter hash, policy version and expiry.
Show why each action is blocked, paused or denied.
Render safe approve and deny command hints using typed grammar.
Mark expired or stale approvals as not actionable.
acceptance_criteria: Approval queue cannot be rendered without exact token binding context.
Expired approvals are rejected and displayed as expired.
Deny path is as visible and easy as approve path.
Blocked action explanations do not include raw secrets.
failure_modes: Blocked action view hides policy reason.
